caption: Sint-Gertrudiskerk, Workum
composition: Unfinished Gothic hall church and separate tower · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Gertrudiskerk at Workum is an unfinished late-Gothic hall church. The nave stops short of the tower, so a gap remains between them. The tower has two stages, a stair turret, and the 1613 crown of a lantern and an onion cupola, not a needle spire. The tower does not lean. It is overcast, about 11.7°C, with wind near 5.0 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The church is closed.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Sint-Gertrudiskerk in Workum at night

qc_notes.note: Gate 1 hold (Cosmo QC 2026-09-26, verified by Cosmo's own read of both masters): the two format masters disagree on the documented tower-nave relationship - the 16:9 shows the brick tower with domed cupola continuous with the long brick nave (no gap between them), while the 4:5 shows the tower freestanding with a clearly separate smaller chapel and an open gap to its right. The card's own geometry anchor 2 requires 'a heavy brick tower stands apart from the nave' and the evidence card states 'the nave stops short of the tower, so a gap remains between them'. One render misrepresents the site configuration. Builder to correct the 16:9 render to show the documented gap and re-push; approval awaits corrected masters.

Gate 1 re-audit PASS (Cosmo QC 2026-09-26): re-rendered masters re-verified - both formats agree the heavy two-stage brick tower stands apart from the brick hall nave with a visible gap, crowned by the open lantern + onion cupola, matching the card's 1613-crown anchor; the earlier tower-nave relationship discrepancy is resolved. On-image caption/scenario/disclosure/signature and Art. 50 PNG metadata verified on the new masters. Hold resolved.
